  "overall_experience": "The Management Accountant found Smartsheet to be a valuable tool for managing financial data and tasks, particularly appreciating its ability to integrate with Excel for data updates. The cost structure for enterprise-level usage and occasional performance lags with extensive data were minor points of frustration."
